title: Depot content in a veyq-subtree manifest
description: The `content` of a Depot node in a download (ADR 0082, docs/apps/depot.md): what the envelope, core's ../veyq-subtree.schema.json, leaves opaque. A content of `type` `depot.file` or `depot.drop-box` is one of these; Depot's own `validateFileContent` / `validateDropBoxContent` (src/web/src/features/depot/exportImport.ts) check it before an import writes anything. Payloads are core's shape (`payload` in the envelope).

file.description: Depot: the one blob of a FILE node. The file's name is the node's name.

dropBox.description: Depot: a DEPOT_DROPBOX node. It carries nothing but what it was: its guests' folders are its FOLDER children (each under the name the drop box shows it by, a repeated name numbered), their files theirs. An importing build creates it as a plain FOLDER - a drop key, guests' identities and links cannot be rebuilt from a download.
